stem_book: A block of mass 2m hangs from the ceiling by a string, and a block of mass m hangs from it by a light spring; the system is at rest. Initial acceleration of the lower block immediately after the string breaks: (a) 3g/2 upwards (b) 2g downwards (c) g/2 downwards (d) None of these
work: Spring force cannot change instantly: on lower block kx − mg = mg − mg = 0 → a = 0
